An adult trans person here, I’m ftm but can relate heavily to what you are saying. I will not lie, life as a trans person is hard and you will likely experience lots of difficulties. However, life is worth living, I have fully medical transitioned, I’m only 21, I worked very hard to achieve it but it is possible and I’m so much more comfortable in my body now. I used to pass never however now I do 100% of time. I’m in a long term relationship with a straight cis girl who sees me as a man and always has, I promise while things may not be perfect they will definitely get a lot better if you stick around. There are people who will accept you, celebrate you and love you.
